- Your DM with me only has this one message, so I can't see what Hollis asked for.
- The brain has notes on Quarrendon Freight Lines, but they're from the North team channels, which you aren't in. I haven't used them.
- Dana Okafor is the account manager on Quarrendon, so the figure would need to come from her or from June.

Before I send anything to Hollis, can you tell me:

1. Which figure it is (for example, the per-seat rate or the contract value), and whether you want me to send the number or have Hollis take it from the source.
2. Where Hollis asked for it, so I can answer in that conversation with the figure and no more.

Once you confirm, I'll either send it to Hollis directly or ask June to confirm it with him, depending on what you want.
